SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(cost),0) AS cost, COALESCE(SUM(platform_fee),0) AS platformFee, COALESCE(SUM(profit),0) AS profit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(revenue),0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(profit),0) / COALESCE(SUM(revenue),0) END AS profitRate FROM profit_order WHERE shop_id = #{q.shopId} AND biz_date BETWEEN #{q.startDate} AND #{q.endDate}
AND sku = #{q.sku}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profit_order (shop_id, order_id, sku, revenue, cost, platform_fee, profit, profit_rate, currency, biz_date) VALUES (#{p.shopId}, #{p.orderId}, #{p.sku}, #{p.revenue}, #{p.cost}, #{p.platformFee}, #{p.profit}, #{p.profitRate}, #{p.currency}, #{p.bizDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revenue=VALUES(revenue), cost=VALUES(cost), platform_fee=VALUES(platform_fee), profit=VALUES(profit), profit_rate=VALUES(profit_rate), currency=VALUES(currency), biz_date=VALUES(biz_date);
